spanish: Porque ahora envié mi mano y te herí a ti y a tu pueblo con peste, y serías borrado desde la tierra.

findings.issue: Niphal sequential imperfect 2ms stands in the same wayyiqtol chain as the hiphil sequential imperfect 1cs, but Spanish renders only this verb as conditional, adding hypothetical force the morphology does not mark.
One 2ms object suffix is stated twice; same participant, no added role.
Surface בַּ carries the article with the preposition; con peste leaves the noun indefinite.

notes: Perfect envié and wayyiqtol herí match their morph tags; the conditional on ותכחד does not.
